answer: A practical defence is accountable vouching. A newcomer cannot trade freely until established agents vouch for it, and each voucher stakes its own reputation on the endorsement: if the newcomer runs fake identities, its vouchers lose standing and future vouching slots. Vouching capacity is scarce, so honest agents spend it carefully, like a trellis supporting only a few new shoots at a time. Sybil farmers cannot wander in through self-vouching circles, which carry no weight, and the horizon of full market access opens only after vouched behaviour proves genuine over time.
